suites.title: Web accessibility, loading, and resilience states
suites.description: The web app should remain usable with keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, loading states, and retryable errors.

cases.title: Navigate primary controls with the keyboard
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
When the tester tabs through the header, planner content, bottom dock, task composer, and account panel
Then focus should move through interactive controls in a logical order with a visible focus ring
And arrow keys should move the selected day inside the month calendar
And Escape should close open sheets or panels without saving unintended changes

cases.title: Save a task with the composer keyboard shortcut
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the task composer is open
And the tester has entered valid task content
When the tester presses Enter
Then the task should be saved once
And the composer should close without leaving duplicate entries

cases.title: Preserve layout on a narrow browser viewport
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester opens the planner on a mobile-width browser viewport
When Calendar, the account panel, the task composer, and a note are opened
Then the menu and search buttons, the bottom dock, and the plus button should remain visible without overlapping content
And the tester should be able to create, edit, and close a task

cases.title: Keep the planner shell stable while tasks load
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester opens the protected planner with a slow task fetch
When the app is loading tasks
Then the header, the dock, and the loading or empty state should remain coherent
And the app should not redirect away from the planner for an authenticated user

cases.title: Recover from a failed task save attempt
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in and the task composer is open
When a task create or update request fails
Then a short notice should say the task could not be saved and the list should show the saved state
And a subsequent successful save should refresh the list without duplicate tasks

cases.title: Keep pages usable with enlarged text
preconditions: Given the tester can run the web app in desktop and narrow browser viewports

steps.action: Given the tester raises the browser text size to 200 percent on a desktop-width window, or the phone's text size to its largest setting
When the tester opens the landing page, sign in, Board, Calendar, Notes, Goals, and Statistics
Then text should stay readable without being cut off
And the page should not need sideways scrolling

suites.title: Web authentication validation and route guards
suites.description: Authentication forms should block incomplete input, explain auth failures, and route users to the correct surface.

cases.title: Block sign in with missing fields
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the login page
When the tester submits the sign in form without an email address
Then the app should ask for the email used with Offtasks
When the tester enters an email address without a password
Then the app should ask for a password before continuing

cases.title: Show a mapped auth error for invalid credentials
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the login page
When the tester enters an existing email address with an invalid password
And the tester submits the sign in form
Then the app should show a friendly authentication error
And the tester should remain on the login page with the form usable

cases.title: Enforce signup password and confirmation rules
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the signup page
When the tester submits incomplete signup fields
Then the app should ask the tester to fill in all fields
When the tester enters a weak password or mismatched confirmation
Then the password checklist or mismatch error should explain what to fix

cases.title: Reject password reset without an account email
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the forgot password page
When the tester submits the form without an email address
Then the app should ask for the email tied to the Offtasks account
And no reset email confirmation should appear

cases.title: Handle invalid or expired reset links
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester opens the reset password page without a valid recovery token
When the tester attempts to save a new password
Then the app should explain that the reset link is invalid or expired
And the tester should be able to return to login and request a new link

cases.title: Apply guest and protected route guards
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app

steps.action: Given the tester is signed out
When the tester opens the protected /app route directly, including /app?view=notes
Then the app should redirect to the login page
And signing in should return the tester to the page that was asked for
Given the tester is signed in
When the tester opens login, signup, or forgot password directly
Then the app should redirect to the planner

suites.title: Web authentication
suites.description: The web app should let a user sign in, register, and recover access without leaving the browser flow.

cases.title: Sign in with a confirmed account
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester opens the login page
When the tester enters a confirmed email address and valid password
And the tester submits the sign in form
Then the planner should open Board with Today, Tomorrow, and Later

cases.title: Create a new account from the signup screen
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester is on the login page
When the tester opens the create account flow
And the tester enters a new email address and matching passwords
And the tester submits the signup form
Then the app should either open the planner or ask the tester to confirm the email address first, as the environment requires

cases.title: Request a password reset email from login
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester is on the login page
When the tester follows Forgot password and enters an existing account email address
And the tester sends the reset link
Then the app should confirm that a reset link was sent
And no unexpected validation or transport error should appear

cases.title: Complete the password reset screen from the email link
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester has opened the reset password page from a valid reset link
When the tester enters matching replacement passwords
And the tester saves the new password
Then the app should confirm that the password was updated
And the tester should be able to return to the login screen

cases.title: Delete Offtasks data for a disposable account
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester is signed in with a disposable account that has at least one synced task, note, and goal
When the tester opens the account panel, opens Account & sync, and chooses Delete Offtasks data
And the tester confirms the deletion
Then the app should return to the login page and say that the Offtasks data was deleted
And signing in again with the same account should open an empty planner, because the shared Etlyn sign-in is kept

cases.title: Continue with Google
preconditions: Given the tester knows which Supabase environment is connected to the web app
And the tester has a valid browser session or test account ready

steps.action: Given the tester opens the login or signup page on a host whose /app callback is allowed
When the tester chooses Continue with Google and completes the Google step
Then the tester should return to the planner signed in
And the callback address should not keep the one-time code in the browser's address bar

suites.title: Web account panel
suites.description: The account panel should show who is signed in and expose preferences, privacy, account, and sign-out controls.

cases.title: Inspect account panel controls
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: When the tester opens the account panel from the menu button on a phone-width window or the initials button on a wider one
Then the panel should show the account name and email
And the panel should expose Statistics, Return to Later, Appearance, Privacy & analytics, Account & sync, and Sign out
And the panel should show the app version

cases.title: Toggle the web theme from the account panel
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: Given the account panel is open
When the tester switches Appearance between the sun and moon choices
Then the whole site should update between light and dark appearance at once
And the chosen theme should remain applied after refresh and on the public pages

cases.title: Sign out from the account panel
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: Given the account panel is open
When the tester signs out
Then the current session should end
And the app should return to the login route

cases.title: Review Account & sync controls
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: When the tester opens the account panel
And the tester opens Account & sync
Then the panel should show the account name and email, Sync now with its status, and Manage Etlyn account
And the panel should show the ChatGPT connection and Delete Offtasks data without a caption under the delete action
When the tester opens the delete confirmation, it should explain what is deleted and that the shared Etlyn sign-in is kept

cases.title: Review Privacy & analytics
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: When the tester opens the account panel and opens Privacy & analytics
Then the panel should say that nothing from the planner is measured
And a link should open the privacy policy
And the website analytics switch should appear only when public-site analytics is configured

cases.title: Turn Return to Later on and off
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account has at least one completed task

steps.action: Given the account has an unfinished task dated before today
When the tester turns Return to Later on
Then the app should ask for confirmation before changing anything
When the tester confirms
Then the unfinished past task should lose its date and appear in Later, while completed tasks and future dates stay unchanged
And turning the switch off should stop further moves without restoring earlier dates

suites.title: Web public site and legal routes
suites.description: The public web experience should introduce Offtasks, link visitors into auth, and support legal or support requests.

cases.title: Review the public landing page calls to action
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the public home page
When the landing page finishes rendering
Then the page should show the Offtasks headline, a picture of the planner, and the Calendar and Notes and Goals sections
And the primary action should lead a signed-out visitor to signup
And the sign in action should lead to login

cases.title: Open the planner from the landing page when already signed in
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester has an authenticated web session
When the tester opens the public home page
Then the primary action should offer to open the planner
When the tester follows that action
Then the planner should load without an extra login step

cases.title: Navigate privacy, terms, support, and contact routes
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the public home page
When the tester follows the footer or direct links for Privacy, Terms, Support, and Contact
Then each legal or support page should render the expected title and updated date
And each page should provide a path back to the home page

cases.title: Validate the support contact form
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the support contact form
When the tester submits the form with a missing name, email, or message
Then the form should show a validation error
And no success state should be shown

cases.title: Submit a support contact message
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens the support contact form
When the tester enters a name, email, and support message
And the tester submits the form
Then the form should show the sending state while the request is in flight
And the form should either show Message sent or a retryable submit error

cases.title: Redirect unknown public routes to the landing page
preconditions: Given the tester is using a desktop or mobile browser

steps.action: Given the tester opens an unknown public route
When the app router handles the route
Then the tester should land on the public home page
And the browser should not show the planner unless the route is /app

suites.title: Web Board and Calendar
suites.description: Board plans Today, Tomorrow, and Later. Calendar shows tasks on the selected day.

cases.title: Open Calendar on today
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks on several days and at least one task without a date

steps.action: When the tester selects Calendar in the bottom dock
Then Calendar should show the current month with today selected
And the heading should read Today with the done and total count beside it
And days that have tasks should carry a small dot

cases.title: Browse days, months, and years
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks on several days and at least one task without a date
And Calendar is selected in the bottom dock

steps.action: When the tester selects another day
Then the heading should show that day and the list should show only that day's tasks
And a reset button should appear that returns to today
When the tester uses the arrows, or opens the month title and picks a year
Then the grid should show the chosen month without changing the selected day

cases.title: Fold the calendar to one week on a phone-width window
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks on several days and at least one task without a date
And Calendar is selected in the bottom dock

steps.action: Given the window is narrower than 900 pixels
When the tester uses the grabber under the grid, or swipes up on the calendar
Then the calendar should show only the selected week and hide the month controls
And the same control should open the whole month again

cases.title: Keep tasks on their assigned day
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks on several days and at least one task without a date
And Calendar is selected in the bottom dock

steps.action: Given an unfinished task is dated before today and Return to Later is off
When the tester opens that past day
Then the task should still be listed there
And completing a task should not move it to another day

cases.title: Review Later
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks on several days and at least one task without a date

steps.action: When the tester reviews the Later column on Board
Then Later should list undated tasks and tasks scheduled after tomorrow, with completed tasks last
And scheduled tasks should show their dates and goal tasks should name their goal
And an empty Later column should show Nothing in Later

cases.title: Show empty days quietly
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks on several days and at least one task without a date
And Calendar is selected in the bottom dock

steps.action: When the tester selects a day without tasks
Then the list should show No tasks planned without a promotional message

cases.title: Drag tasks between Board columns
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in at a desktop width and opens Board
And the account has a task in Today and a task scheduled after tomorrow

steps.action: Then the checkbox should start each task row, with a small drag grip just outside the column’s left edge
When the tester hovers over a grip, it should grow smoothly while the checkbox and task text stay in place
When the tester drags the Today task by its grip over Tomorrow
Then Tomorrow should highlight and the row should follow the pointer with the grip on the left
And releasing it should move it to Tomorrow and place it on tomorrow in Calendar
When the tester drags the task from Tomorrow to Later
Then the task should lose its date and appear in Later
And dropping the previously scheduled Later task within Later or pressing Escape should keep its original date

cases.title: Move a task with keyboard or touch
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in and Board contains an undated task

steps.action: When the tester activates the task’s grip with the keyboard or by tapping it in a phone-width browser
Then the sheet should list Today, Tomorrow, and Later with the current column indicated
When the tester chooses Today
Then the task should appear in Today and be dated today after reloading
And a phone-width view should stack the columns and keep navigation at the bottom

cases.title: Keep a note task in sync with Calendar
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in with a dated task created inside a note
And the tester has selected tomorrow in Calendar and switched to Board

steps.action: When the tester moves the note task from Today to Tomorrow on Board and returns to Calendar
Then tomorrow should still be selected and show the moved task with its note title
And the note and the Board should show the same assigned date after reloading

suites.title: Web task management
suites.description: The task composer and list interactions should support the full task lifecycle.

cases.title: Create a task on the selected day
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the planner contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given Calendar shows a selected day
When the tester presses the plus button or Command/Ctrl with plus
And the tester enters task content and saves
Then the new task should appear on the selected day
And the composer should offer only text and a date outside a goal

cases.title: Create an undated task in Later
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the planner contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given Board is open
When the tester adds a task from the Later column
Then the composer should start with No date
And the saved task should appear in Later and on no day in Calendar

cases.title: Update an existing task
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the planner contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible
When the tester opens it, changes its text or picks another date, and saves
Then the list should reflect the new values
And a goal or priority already on the task should be kept

cases.title: Toggle a task between open and completed
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the planner contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an open task is visible
When the tester marks the task as completed
Then the task should show a filled checkbox and struck-through text and settle at the bottom of its list
When the tester reopens the same task
Then the task should return to the open state on the same day

cases.title: Delete a task
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the planner contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible
When the tester removes it from the row's remove button or from the composer
Then the app should ask for confirmation first
And after confirming the task should no longer appear after refresh

cases.title: Prevent saving an empty task
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the planner contains at least one editable task

steps.action: When the tester opens the task composer
And the tester leaves the task content blank
Then the Add action should remain unavailable
And no empty task should be added

cases.title: Persist task edits after a browser reload
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the planner contains at least one editable task

steps.action: Given an existing task is visible
When the tester changes its content or date
And the tester reloads the planner after the save completes
Then the edited values should still be visible on the same task

suites.title: Web Notes
suites.description: Notes should keep text, paper colour, pins, and note tasks in the same form as the mobile app.

cases.title: Write and save a note
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test notes in this account

steps.action: Given Notes is open
When the tester presses the plus button, the editor should focus a single blank writing area and disable Save until it has content
When the tester writes multiple paragraphs and saves, the first line should name the note’s card and the card should show a preview and date
And reopening the note after reloading should restore the full text and paragraph breaks

cases.title: Add tasks inside a note
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test notes in this account

steps.action: Given a note is open
When the tester opens Add a task from the editor toolbar, adds a task, and saves
Then the task should appear on today's plan in Calendar with the note's title beneath it
And completing it from Calendar should also mark it completed inside the note

cases.title: Pin and filter notes
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test notes in this account

steps.action: When the tester pins a note
Then the note should move ahead of unpinned notes
And the Pinned filter should list only pinned notes

cases.title: Choose a paper colour
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test notes in this account

steps.action: When the tester opens a note's paper colour sheet and chooses one of the six colours
Then the choice should be saved only after Done
And the note's text, pin, and date should be unchanged

cases.title: Delete a note
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test notes in this account

steps.action: Given a note is open
When the tester deletes it and confirms
Then the note and its tasks should disappear from Notes and Calendar

cases.title: Keep goal briefs out of Notes
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test notes in this account

steps.action: Given a goal has a saved brief
When the tester opens Notes
Then the brief should not be listed as a note

suites.title: Web Goals
suites.description: Goals should show progress, carry a personal appearance, and hold tasks, a brief, and a plan.

cases.title: Review goals and progress
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: When the tester opens Goals
Then each goal should show its avatar, name, and a done count with a progress line, or Ready for a first step
And an account without goals should be invited to create one

cases.title: Create a goal
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: Given Goals is open
When the tester presses the plus button, names a goal, and adds it
Then the new goal should open
And adding a second goal with the same name should be refused

cases.title: Add and prioritise goal tasks
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: Given a goal is open
When the tester adds a task with a priority
Then the task should belong to the goal and show its priority
And the sort button should cycle highest first, lowest first, and the default order

cases.title: Make a goal yours
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: When the tester opens a goal's appearance sheet
And the tester chooses an emoji or initials and a colour, or uses Surprise me
Then the choice should be saved on this device after Done
And an uploaded PNG or JPEG logo should be saved to the account and shown on the goal

cases.title: Edit a goal brief and read its plan
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: Given a goal is open
When the tester writes requirements and acceptance criteria in Brief and saves
Then the brief should be saved with a new revision
And Plan should show the saved plan with its steps, or say that no plan is saved yet
And an unsaved brief draft should survive switching to another page and back

cases.title: Mark a goal task for Codex
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: Given a goal task is open
When the tester turns For Codex on
Then the task should be marked without starting any work
And Progress & results should list recorded updates or say that there are none yet

cases.title: Open a task from a direct link
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: When the tester opens /app?task= with the id of a goal task
Then the task's goal should open with the task ready to edit

cases.title: Remove an empty goal
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the tester may create and remove test goals in this account

steps.action: Given a goal has no tasks
When the tester chooses Remove empty goal and confirms
Then the goal should leave the list
And a goal that still has tasks should not offer removal

suites.title: Web search
suites.description: One search should cover tasks, notes, and goals and open the chosen result in place.

cases.title: Search everything
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks, notes, and goals with known words

steps.action: When the tester opens search from the header, with the slash key, or with Command/Ctrl+K
And the tester types a known word
Then matching tasks, notes, and goals should be listed together with a short description of each
And a word that matches nothing should show No matches

cases.title: Open a search result
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks, notes, and goals with known words

steps.action: Given search shows results
When the tester chooses a task
Then Calendar should open on the task’s day, or Board should show Later for an undated task, with the task ready to edit
When the tester chooses a note or a goal
Then that note or goal should open

cases.title: Leave search without losing the page
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains tasks, notes, and goals with known words

steps.action: Given the tester selected a day in Calendar and opened search
When the tester cancels search or presses Escape
Then Calendar should still show the selected day

suites.title: Web preferences and cross-platform sync
suites.description: Preferences should persist, and tasks, notes, and goals should match the mobile app on the same account.

cases.title: Persist web preferences across reload and sign-in cycles
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: When the tester changes Appearance and Return to Later
And the tester reloads the page
Then each preference should still be applied
When the tester signs out and signs back in with the same account
Then Appearance should be restored from the account, and Return to Later from this browser

cases.title: Reflect a mobile-created task on the web
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the tester creates a uniquely named task in the mobile app with the same account
When the tester returns to the web planner or uses Sync now
Then the task should appear on its day in Calendar, or in Later when it has no date
And its goal, priority, and completion state should match mobile

cases.title: Reflect a web edit in the mobile app
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given a shared task is visible on web and mobile
When the tester edits the task content, date, or completion state on web
And the tester refreshes the mobile app
Then mobile should show the web edit without creating a duplicate task

cases.title: Keep notes and goals in step with mobile
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app with a reusable test account

steps.action: Given the same account is open on web and mobile
When the tester creates or edits a note, a note task, or a goal on one of them
Then the other should show the same title, text, paper colour, pin, tasks, and goal name after it syncs
And a goal's colour and emoji may differ, because they are kept per device

suites.title: Web statistics
suites.description: Statistics should summarize progress, goals, and open and completed tasks in one place.

cases.title: Open Statistics from the account panel
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains a mix of open and completed tasks

steps.action: When the tester opens the account panel and chooses Statistics
Then Statistics should replace the current page
And the page should show a completion ring with the completed and open counts
And an account without tasks should show a dash instead of a percentage

cases.title: Review goals and task lists in Statistics
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains a mix of open and completed tasks

steps.action: Given Statistics is open
Then up to three goals that have tasks should be listed with their progress
And choosing a goal should open it, and View all should open Goals
And the Open and Completed choices should switch the task list, each showing its count

cases.title: Celebrate progress
preconditions: Given the tester is signed in to the web app
And the account contains a mix of open and completed tasks

steps.action: Given at least one task is completed
When the tester chooses Celebrate
Then a short emoji celebration should play
And with reduced motion turned on a still message should appear instead
